hero.description: EduPlay is the platform with educational games for Romanian kids ages 3–12. Built with teachers, tested with real children.

visual.collageLabel: EduPlay preview with games, progress, and safety

utility.message: Safe games, visible progress, and careful Romanian language.

carousel.description: Every game is built with teachers and tested with real children. Proper Romanian, no ads, designed for short attention spans.

featured.title: Rainbow of Colors
featured.description: Recognize, match, mix. A tactile game that teaches kids every color of the rainbow through short mini-adventures.
featured.learns: Color recognition · Visual vocabulary · Hand-eye coordination

audienceSplit.description: Teachers get a tool. Families get an experience. Kids get serious play.

createClass.title: Create your class
createClass.description: Add students with a simple access code. No emails needed for kids.

assignGames.title: Assign games
assignGames.description: Filter by age, subject, or difficulty. Assign per student or per class.

seeProgress.title: See progress
seeProgress.description: Scores, time on task, chapters completed. Sortable, exportable table.

teacherInvites.title: Teacher invites
teacherInvites.description: You get an access code for your child. You see progress, the child plays.

childChooses.title: Child chooses
childChooses.description: A visual library of age-appropriate games. No ads, no upsells.

learnByPlaying.title: Learn by playing
learnByPlaying.description: Earn stars, unlock chapters, learn without realizing it.

audienceSplit.heading: EduPlay keeps everyone connected to learning.
audienceSplit.summary: Like a living classroom journal, every role sees exactly what they need: activities for teachers, games for students, progress for families, and clarity for the school.

teachers.title: Teachers see progress without complicated reports
teachers.description: Create classes, send appropriate activities, and track which child needs support in a simple classroom workflow.
teachers.proof: Planning, assignments, and progress in one place

students.title: Students learn through clear, guided games
students.description: Children sign in quickly with class details, choose visual exercises, and get immediate feedback without distractions or confusing menus.
students.proof: Large targets, readable text, and a kid-friendly pace

families.title: Families stay connected to learning
families.description: Parents see what their child is working on, can continue at home, and understand progress through short messages in plain language.

admins.title: School leaders get a clear school-level view
admins.description: Activities, classes, and progress can be tracked consistently, with attention to privacy and primary-school needs.
admins.proof: Useful data without unnecessary admin load

trust.description: We don't just say we're safe. Here's what that actually means, and where you can verify it.

gdpr.title: EU-grade GDPR
gdpr.description: Data stored in the EU, processed only to run the platform. Right to erasure, right to portability.

noTrackers.title: Zero trackers on kids' routes
noTrackers.description: ESLint blocks any third-party analytics import on kids' pages at build time. Verified in every PR.

romanian.title: Proper Romanian
romanian.description: Correct diacritics (ă, î, ș, ț, â). Vocabulary aligned with the national curriculum. Authored in Romania.

free.title: Free for teachers
free.description: Full access for the teacher and their class. No limits, no upsells, no surprises.

trust.evidenceTitle: Support for the classroom, not just another app.
trust.evidenceDescription: EduPlay keeps the energy of play while presenting information as a school tool: guided, measurable, and easy to explain to families.

teacher.title: Teacher guide
teacher.description: Short steps for creating classes, assigning games, and reading progress without technical training.

research.title: Applied research
research.description: Activities built for repetition, fast feedback, and tasks suited to primary-school children.

progress.title: Progress evidence
progress.description: Teachers and families see what was completed and where the child needs extra support.

privacy.title: Data handled with care
privacy.description: The experience is designed with attention to privacy, controlled access, and information relevant to learning.

romanian.title: Romanian from the start
romanian.description: Copy, flows, and explanations are designed for teachers, students, and families in Romania.

band.title: Privacy, context, and progress explained clearly.
band.description: The evidence band shifts from general promises to concrete signals: who sees the data, how progress is tracked, and why families can trust the flow.

finalCta.description: A free account, no credit card, no trial period. Just EduPlay, complete, free for teachers.

footer.description: Interactive educational platform for Romanian kids ages 3–12. Made by teachers, for teachers and families.

gdprBadge.title: EU GDPR
gdprBadge.description: Data processed exclusively in the EU

whyChoose.title: Less administration. More visible learning.
whyChoose.description: The section after the hero moves from promoting games to the real reason a school would use the platform: it connects activities, progress, and families in one coherent space.

fragmented.description: Digital activities are scattered across apps, worksheets, and parent messages.

progress.description: Teachers lose time figuring out who worked, what they understood, and where to revisit.

context.description: Families receive too little context to support learning at home.

unified.description: Classes, students, games, and progress in one coherent primary-school workflow.

progress.description: Teachers can quickly see progress and choose the right next activity.

safe.description: Children work in a safe space with short instructions and immediate feedback.

preview.title: Everything that matters, visible
preview.note: Teachers can send activities, students work intuitively, and families get context without changing the classroom flow.
